en.p: For three real numbers $a$, $b$, $k$, the two points $\mathrm{A}(a,\,a+k)$ and $\mathrm{B}(b,\,b+k)$ lie on the curve $C:\ x^2-2xy+2y^2=15$. When the tangent line to curve $C$ at point A and the tangent line to curve $C$ at point B are perpendicular to each other, find the value of $k^2$. (Here $a+2k\ne 0$, $b+2k\ne 0$.) [4 points]
